mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_checkin ( user_id, checkin_date, meal_time, image_object_key, image_media_type, total_energy_kcal, total_protein_g, total_fat_g, total_carbohydrate_g, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{checkinDate}, #{mealTime}, #{imageObjectKey}, #{imageMediaType}, #{totalEnergyKcal}, #{totalProteinG}, #{totalFatG}, #{totalCarbohydrateG}, NOW(), NOW() )
